answer:
Why it failed: CloudFormation rejected the template before creating anything: "Template format error: Unresolved resource dependencies [PublicSubnetB] in the Resources block". The run had subnet_count=1. In agnosticd/agnosticd-v2:ansible/configs/retail-edge-pos/files/cloud_providers/ec2_cloud_template.j2:38, the PublicSubnetB subnet is wrapped in {% if subnet_count | int > 1 %} ... {% endif %} (ending at line 36), but PublicSubnetBRouteTableAssociation, which does !Ref PublicSubnetB, sits outside that guard. With one subnet the association is rendered and the subnet it references is not. The fix is to move the association inside the same if block.

What it changed before failing: 3 tasks reported changed.
- "Create the SSH key pair in AWS" created the EC2 key pair retail-edge-pos-k9fhs-key.
- "Create the lab assets bucket" created the S3 bucket retail-edge-pos-assets-k9fhs in us-east-2.
- "Render the CloudFormation template" wrote /tmp/k9fhs/ec2_cloud_template.yaml on the execution node. That is local only.

The stack itself failed validation, so no VPC, subnet or instance exists. Clean up the key pair and the bucket.
